scoring_justification: Checker recomputes conductance reduction factors from raw conductance values and evaluates chirality-dependent trends with thresholds derived from paper-reported factors.

hidden_assets.purpose: Thresholds for conductance reduction factors and plausible ranges for undeformed conductance
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.2 and text: armchair bending factor ~1.01, tip factor ~1.05; zigzag bending factor ~1.9, tip factor up to 1.7e4. Converted to threshold_or_better with generous slack.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Derived from paper's reported values; thresholds chosen to allow implementation variance while enforcing correct trend.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly derived from the paper's actual quantitative results; no alternative hidden labels needed.

armchair_bending_40.description: Conductance of (6,6) armchair tube under 40° bending

armchair_tip_25.description: Conductance of (6,6) armchair tube under 25° tip deformation

zigzag_bending_40.description: Conductance of (12,0) zigzag tube under 40° bending

zigzag_tip_25.description: Conductance of (12,0) zigzag tube under 25° tip deformation

outputs.description: Six conductance values (in units of 2e²/h) that enable the checker to verify the chirality‑dependent conductance drop.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker recomputes reduction factors (undeformed / deformed) for each case and applies threshold_or_better criteria consistent with the paper's reported trend. The output only provides raw conductance values; tolerances are defined hidden.
